risk_summary: The disclosure contains substantial quantified operational and investment detail, but relies heavily on projected timelines, capacities, approvals, and financing that are not assured. The $53 million operating cash outflow, $209.7 million working-capital deficit, dependence on short-term borrowings, and auditor-identified going-concern doubt indicate severe liquidity and execution risk. Repeated expansion language and optimistic projections partially obscure the central funding and viability concerns.
